name: Lightkeepers
desc: An ancient organization that has long defended Nod-Krai's freedom and peace against the ceaseless incursions and Wild Hunt attacks launched by the Abyss.

If you want to know more about a certain land, you have to ask the people who live there.
Yet when faced with too many choices, and no way to decide... perhaps you need a witch's keen eye to give you "guidance."

<color=#ffd780>April 27, 2025</color>
The ancient organization that has long defended Nod-Krai's freedom and peace against the ceaseless incursions and Wild Hunt attacks launched by the Abyss, now severely weakened from battles past. In the face of new threats, none can say for sure if the new generation of Ratniki will remain able to carry out their mission...

customize.desc: The first Torchbearer and founder of the Lightkeepers.

customize.text: The first Torchforger, the Lightkeeper's founder from Snezhnaya, and the first Starshyna.

customize.name: Aila
customize.desc: The first Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions, who lived 500 years ago.

customize.name: Frostmoon Scions
customize.desc: The descendants of the legendary golden realm, who chose to find new homes among the mountains and forests after abandoning all civilization. The only thing they never forsook was their faith in the "Moon Goddess."

customize.text: , who gave Solovei the Arrow of Terpikeraunas, capable of purging the Abyssal energy.

Nikita
The Lightkeepers' Starshyna and Illuga's adoptive father.

customize.name: Sigurd
customize.desc: A valiant warrior who resisted the dark calamity in ancient days. Though his life's spark has been extinguished, his unbending will has yet to fade, and those who swore to become hunters of the Wild Hunt continue his endless battle even today. The dark abyss's corrosion has seeped into his marrow, causing him to lose his way, but the desire to defend hearth and home will surely reignite, reawakening him to continue a bitter, eternal battle.

customize.text:
The legendary Starshyna wielded a longsword, and his monster-slaying prowess was one of a kind. He vanished in the wake of a great battle, and an empty grave was built in his honor.

customize.desc: A Lightkeeper of Nod-Krai, guardian of a lighthouse and graveyard on a northern isle. An enigmatic gentleman, cultured and courtly.

customize.text: A fae who became a Ratnik to understand human life. He was awakened long ago by a band of Ratniki on a small island that later became Final Night Cemetery.

customize.name: Illuga
customize.desc: A member of the Lightkeepers' investigation squad, the Nightmare Orioles, he is much like the lantern he carries — both a guiding light and a source of care.
